title: Provision for Air Conditioners in Deep Bhavan - Electrical works

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra, Cochin

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Cochin

scope.item: Provision for air conditioners in Deep Bhavan - electrical works

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; to reach one day before last day of bid submission.
